text:
Ilya (product): Quick sync: we're exploring a per-invocation cost 'peek' in the Cost Dashboard — wants: token breakdown, cache credit, model variant, and a toggle to amortize cache credits tenant-vs-shared. Need consensus on telemetry and API path.
Ben (eng): We can add a summary endpoint + optional expand=trace. Important: keep default payload < 1KB per row for dashboard performance.
Rae (platform): Telemetry gaps: no slab_id in router events; model_variant sometimes missing for fallback flows. We'll need small proto changes.
Mina (design): UI will show a compact row with stacked token bar and a small chevron to open popover. Popover requests expand=trace lazily. Also want a sampled badge when showing sampled traces.
econ-bot: Note: sampled full-trace retention is 0.5%. Increasing sampling will raise long-term storage and querying costs.
Ilya (product): Proposed API: GET /api/costs/invocations?start=...&end=...&expand=trace,slab&sample_pct=0.5
Ilya (product): sample payload: [ { "invocation_id":"inv_zz", "ts":"2026-03-10T10:00:00Z", "model":"r-v2-3B", "model_variant":"q1", "tokens_prompt":"30","tokens_completion":"80","tokens_cached":"12","cache_credit_usd":"0.0012","cost_usd":"0.0038","simulate_no_cache_usd":"0.0050","slab_id":"slab_a1b2","slab_scope":"tenant" } ]
Ben (eng): Backend plan: create hourly pre-agg table of avoided_tokens per slab_id and per-hour. Summary endpoint reads from that; expand=trace hits sampled raw traces. We'll need to instrument slab_id at router.
Rae (platform): I'll add slab_id and chosen_variant to the telemetry proto and push an RFC. We'll gate rollout to 10% of traffic first.
Mina (design): UX ask: show 'confidence' (low/med/high) based on sampling density, and an alternate subtitle 'estimated if cache disabled'.
econ-bot: Reminder: adding slab_id to all telemetry will increase metric cardinality. Consider optional emission only on prefetch hits.
Ilya (product): Decisions: 1) support pre-agg + sampled trace; 2) slab_id optional but emitted when prefetch used; 3) amortization rules: tenant scoped => full credit, shared => prorate by active usage.
Ben (eng): Action items: Ben to prototype pre-agg job (ETA 4d), Rae to RFC telemetry changes (ETA 2d), Mina to upload updated mock + copy (ETA 2d), Ilya to write endpoint spec + rate-limit proposal (ETA 3d).
Rae (platform): Also will add quota/costing for expand=trace param. Might make expand=trace an authenticated premium call.
Ilya (product): Great. Let's reconvene after RFCs. :rocket:
